note: Evidence rule (B30, tools/evidence.js). A confirmed row's datesSourceUrl must be on the organiser's or society's own domain: the same registrable domain as the row's url (subdomains count, e.g. events.aats.org for aats.org), or one of the 'official' entries below. Add an entry only after opening the page and seeing that the organiser or society runs it (a congress's own domain, or the organiser's page on a congress-company platform). 'path' limits a shared platform host to one event. 'aggregators' are listing sites: never a date source, even when the row's url points there.
